subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should OpenClaw accept the one-way device-identity cutover in which legacy JSON identities require explicit Doctor migration and older JSON-only binaries must not share the migrated state directory?
rationale: The proposed behavior intentionally changes upgrade, downgrade, recovery, and multi-process compatibility semantics; correctness tests cannot determine whether that product contract is acceptable.

options.title: Accept the cutover with recovery safeguards
options.body: Approve the SQLite-only runtime model after the reset fix, real upgrade/recovery proof, and prerequisite merge/rebase confirm that existing users have a supported recovery path.

options.title: Defer for a different upgrade contract
options.body: Pause the PR to define a downgrade or mixed-version policy that preserves a supported identity path beyond explicit Doctor migration.

recommendation.title: Accept the cutover with recovery safeguards
recommendation.body: Approve the SQLite-only runtime model after the reset fix, real upgrade/recovery proof, and prerequisite merge/rebase confirm that existing users have a supported recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The current migration design and its stated upgrade contract are authored and documented across this state-storage stack.
